output_list.code:
name = tokenName;                                   
        symbol = tokenSymbol;                               
        decimals = decimalUnits;
output_list.reason: The symbol and name of the token is set at the time of token creation. These are public variables and anyone can access them. If they can be changed, it would allow people to change the symbol and name of the token which can lead to confusion. Attacker can exploit this vulnerability to manipulate the symbol and name of the token, leading to loss of trust among users.
